label: reported

reported.how: Agent37's settled compute_micros for this instance in its workspace usage report; managed services billed to the instance are left out.

excluded: Performance instances (compute at 4x the default rate) are not priced here; the default and VM instance types are. VM compute is 2.5x the default rate (2 vCPU and 4 GB at $2.00 and $1.75 make the page's $11.36 a month with 4 GB of disk).
A sleeping instance parked in cold storage bills $0.03 per GB-month on its compressed bytes instead of its reserved disk; those bytes are not reported per instance, so that time is not priced here.
Managed LLM, Brave search, Composio and paid-tool calls debit the same wallet per instance, within a budget that defaults to $0; they are not part of a sandbox's price.
The wallet is prepaid; the $5 sign-up credit, top-ups and instance limits by top-up tier are account terms, not per-instance cost.
